authorization: User explicitly authorized R1_A relative-to-parent walk-forward incremental prediction diagnostic.
estimand: On every original evaluable R1_A event in each subsequent Development fold, compare squared prediction error of the fixed parent-feature ridge model against the same ridge model with one additional R1_A indicator. Positive mean loss difference means better predictions relative to this specific benchmark, not causal effect or incremental matched-trade PnL.

scope.STAR50: Not estimated: its pre2021 context lacks a full prior-year warm-up. No substitution of later transport years.
scope.evaluation_event_population: Exactly the 1752 original CSI1000 Development R1_A events already recorded in development_pairs.csv. Warm-up events remain in coverage ledger but are not scored. The inherited terminal 240-bar-complete cohort is disclosed; not a prospective all-event admission protocol.

training_population.compiler: Reuse build_r1_events_and_controls with original thresholds and structural nonoverlap, restricted to 2015-2020, then retain R1_A only. Include each original event and each original eligible non-event control-pool minute ONCE, not the selected matched controls.
training_population.non_event_definition: Inherited parent-state candidate pool: not an R1_A entry and not within the previous 240 observed bars after an R1_A entry; no future-treatment exclusion. This is a restricted background population, not all possible market minutes.
training_population.weights: Equal weight per eligible training row, identical rows and weights for both models; no event oversampling, balancing, clipping or tail trimming.

timing.fold_assignment: calendar year of INFORMATION timestamp, not future entry/exit timestamp
timing.retrain: Once before the first information timestamp in each evaluation year, expanding from 2015. Model fixed during that year.
timing.label_maturity: For each h separately, training entry+h <= final observed index before evaluation information year. No unfinished target enters fitting, normalization or support diagnostics.
timing.preprocessing: Training-only arithmetic means and ddof=0 SD for every non-intercept feature; zero SD replaced by 1. No test clipping or test-informed transformation.
timing.causality_audit: Check training maximum label end against fold cutoff; verify original R1_A identities/features on five historical price prefixes; synthetic tests mutate future labels/features without affecting prior fits. Historical compiler may access complete pre2021 prices to reconstruct the established event stream, but no future value is supplied to a fit/forecast.

models.family: Linear ridge only, no interactions or hyperparameter selection
models.objective: mean((y-intercept-Z*beta)^2)+0.001*sum(beta^2); intercept unpenalized. Fit by deterministic float64 linear solve.
models.enhanced_addition: One binary R1_A indicator, normalized with training mean/SD like other non-intercept features
models.degenerate_or_failed_fit: Record all affected event-horizon rows as unscored with explicit reason; do not substitute another model or favorable subset.
models.sanity_references: Zero forecast and the past mixed-training mean are scored as descriptive baseline-adequacy references, not alternative models eligible for selection.

evaluation.primary_score: mean((y-p_parent)^2-(y-p_parent_plus_R1A)^2) on identical forward-event rows, units bp^2
full_reporting: baseline/enhanced MSE RMSE MAE mean error
unchanged non-event background out-of-time context scores
evaluation.dependence: Retain actual event entry/exit dates; all-event daily sums including zero-event days and fixed lag 0/1/5/20/60 products. These are descriptive loss concentration diagnostics, NOT independent sample counts, SEs or trading portfolio risk.
evaluation.tail_accounting: Top ceil(1%) and ceil(5%) of absolute daily loss differences as a share of total absolute daily differences; no trimming.
evaluation.support: For every scored event report any of four continuous features outside prior mixed-training or prior non-event coordinate ranges, missing prior same-direction/information-clock non-event stratum, nearest standardized non-event distance in that stratum, and prior event/non-event counts. Diagnostics only; retain all forecasts, never filter outcomes by these flags.
evaluation.support_limit: Coordinate bounds and nearest distance do not prove joint support, exchangeability, model adequacy or no omitted information.
evaluation.descriptive_consistency_flag: Per h only: pooled loss improvement>0, improvement in at least 4/5 years, and pooled improvement>0 for both directions. Flag is descriptive, not statistical significance, horizon selection or strategy promotion.
evaluation.interpretation: Report baseline adequacy versus zero/past-mean references alongside incremental scores. Negative result rejects no universal nonlinear information; positive result establishes no superiority over all parent models. The R1_A flag is deterministic from price history and only adds a representation relative to the declared finite feature set.

budget: Five annual folds x seven horizons x two nested ridge models = at most 70 fits. One source scope, one fixed lambda, no model/feature/horizon/side/year sweep. Stop after this diagnostic and interpretation; no automatic replacement candidate.
preserved: No source byte/old signal/pair/outcome/freeze edits; old strict-control failure stays closed. New experiment is prediction, not revival of its selected paired-return table.
